## CBETH-REDEMPTION-BASIS-001

Research-only / outcome-blind source feasibility.

### Mechanism
cbETH has an explicit protocol conversion rate while its market price may differ. Coinbase redemption is access-constrained and may involve a material waiting period, so a market-vs-conversion basis can exist without frictionless instantaneous arbitrage.

### Frozen protocol anchor
- official Ethereum cbETH: 0xBe9895146f7AF43049ca1c1AE358B0541Ea49704
- historical anchor: block-pinned exchangeRate()
- totalSupply() descriptive only
- no mutable current API value may substitute for historical on-chain state.

### Frozen market source
- direct Uniswap V3 cbETH/WETH only
- canonical V3 factory
- fee tiers 100 / 500 / 3000 / 10000
- token ordering verified
- historical slot0 + liquidity tied to exact canonical blocks.

### Fixed source sentinels
16M / 18M / 20M / 22M / 24M plus current finalized.

SOURCE_PASS requires the protocol anchor at all fixed points and one same direct pool with positive liquidity + valid state at >=4/5 historical sentinels plus finalized.

No synthetic cbETH/USD ÷ ETH/USD rescue is allowed in this LAB_ID.

### Transport
Prepared source probe uses:
- PublicNode only for canonical block headers;
- BlockMachine for historical contract state;
- EIP-1898 exact blockHash + requireCanonical;
- explicit timeout/retry.

Workflow is manual-only and has NOT been dispatched while repository Actions are congested.

### Boundaries
No basis threshold, holding horizon, return, PnL, live trading, wallet/exchange mutation or main merge has been opened.

SOURCE_PASS would earn zero promotion credit and only authorize a separately frozen predictor-only census.
